auditTitle: JARVIS Live Intelligence Provider Verification Matrix

providers.name: Google Search Grounding (Gemini 2.5 Flash)
providers.mechanism: First-party Google Search Grounding via Gemini generateContent API (tools: [{ googleSearch: {} }])
providers.runtimeProof: Verified live query 'What is the latest stable release of Node.js as of today?' returned actual webSearchQueries, groundingChunks (stackchief.com, nodejs.org, latestn.com), and groundingSupports.
providers.limitations: Requires active GEMINI_API_KEY and valid Gemini API quota. Subject to Google rate limits.

providers.name: Google News RSS Feed
providers.mechanism: XML RSS feed fetch from https://news.google.com/rss/search?q=... with XML DOM/regex normalization and CBMi token scrubbing
providers.runtimeProof: Verified 100 live news articles fetched with titles, publisher names, and links without anti-bot blocks.
providers.limitations: Direct article URLs redirect through Google wrappers; titles and publisher names are normalized.

providers.name: DuckDuckGo HTML Web Search
providers.mechanism: Zero-key HTML search scraping via https://html.duckduckgo.com/html/?q=... with uddg URL decoding and ad filtering
providers.runtimeProof: Verified organic search returns 5+ clean web results with snippets and normalized domains.
providers.limitations: HTML format dependent; rate limited if queried with high concurrency.

providers.name: Headless Chromium Google Search Web UI
providers.mechanism: Playwright Chromium headless navigation to https://www.google.com/search?q=...
providers.runtimeProof: Automated headless navigation triggers Google anti-bot challenge (/sorry/index). Engine transparently detects CAPTCHA gate, reports blockedByCaptcha: true, and falls back to DuckDuckGo HTML and Google Search Grounding without attempting illicit CAPTCHA bypass.
providers.limitations: Headless automated scraping is blocked by Google anti-bot gates. Production primary is Google Search Grounding.

providers.name: OpenStreetMap Nominatim Geocoding & POI Catalog
providers.mechanism: HTTPS REST API queries to https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/search and /reverse with 1 req/sec rate limit and User-Agent compliance
providers.runtimeProof: Verified geocoding 'Gateway of India, Mumbai' returned exact coordinates (18.9219841, 72.8346543) and reverse geocoding returned full formatted address.
providers.limitations: Nominatim usage policy enforces max 1 request/second throttling and caching.

providers.name: Open Source Routing Machine (OSRM)
providers.mechanism: HTTPS REST API queries to https://router.project-osrm.org/route/v1/ with driving, walking ('foot'), cycling ('bike') profiles and alternatives=true
providers.runtimeProof: Verified route calculation from Gateway of India to Marine Drive returned 2.87 km driving distance and 8.9 mins base duration with step-by-step maneuvers.
providers.limitations: OSRM provides road geometry distance and baseline duration without real-time congestion or traffic accidents.

providers.name: Google Maps Platform Geocoding API
providers.mechanism: Direct Google Maps Geocoding REST API (https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/geocode/json)
providers.runtimeProof: Blocked due to absent GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY in .env. Engine cleanly falls back to OpenStreetMap Nominatim and reports missingGoogleMapsPlatformKeys: ['GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY'].
providers.limitations: Requires user to supply paid Google Maps Platform API key in .env.

providers.name: Google Maps Platform Places API
providers.mechanism: Direct Google Maps Places REST API (https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/place/...)
providers.runtimeProof: Blocked due to absent GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY in .env. Engine falls back to Google Maps Web UI card parsing via Chromium and Nominatim POIs.
providers.limitations: Requires user to supply paid Google Maps Platform API key in .env.

providers.name: Google Maps Platform Directions & Live Traffic API
providers.mechanism: Direct Google Maps Directions API with departure_time=now traffic model
providers.runtimeProof: Blocked due to absent GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY. Base routes computed via OSRM, live traffic scraped when browser session open, missing key reported honestly.
providers.limitations: Official live traffic delays require Google Maps Platform API key.
